title: The reeve's central promise thread ('The Barrow Doors': seal after vs. leave open) was preempted off-screen when the priest's blessing opened the doors before I ever reached the throne. At the throne the Hollow King only says 'Leave it however you see fit' — no explicit seal/open choice was ever offered, so the promise I broke never gets a real payoff.
where: Throne of the Barrow/talk to hollow king ('the barrow doors — seal or open?')
